integrity: Standalone exact proof and independent standard-library finite checker; computational sampling is not asserted to prove the infinite formula. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns the order-three generalized Pell recurrence modulo powers of two; it does not classify odd prime-power or higher-order cases. The maximal period is known from standard-seed period theory; the proposed contribution is the complete all-seed valuation strata and multiplicities. A general unpublished or differently formulated matrix-orbit theorem may cover it.
title: Complete all-seed dyadic cycle spectrum for the three-step Pell recurrence
